name: Nevada Canyon Gold Corp.
description: Nevada Canyon Gold Corp. is a gold-focused natural resource company headquartered in Reno, Nevada, operating a three-pronged business model of mineral royalty creation and acquisition, precious-metals streaming, and an exploration project accelerator. The company's principal activities are focused in Nevada, widely regarded as one of the world's premier gold mining jurisdictions, with interests in projects including the Lapon Canyon and Olinghouse properties. Nevada Canyon holds royalties and earn-in agreements rather than operating mines directly, positioning it as an early-stage royalty and streaming company.
